headline: Core CPI 0.3%, Dec hike fully priced, 10y auction tail, Nasdaq futures +1.5%, cash bonds shut
stance: Cash bonds are shut, so equities price Tuesday's CPI alone today. Nasdaq futures +1.5% say AI earnings beat the Fed for one session.

news.head: CoreWeave +13% pre-market on raised 2026 guide
news.body: Q3 revenue $3.66bn vs $3.54bn expected. 2026 revenue guide $13.0-13.3bn, backlog ~$133bn. Shares +13.2% (~4:18am ET).

news.head: Nvidia -5.5% Tuesday, +3.6% pre-market
news.body: Close was the lowest since Mar 30, on the Huang probe. Three House chairs want a Nov 18 briefing. Shares +3.6% (~4am ET).

news.head: Anthropic banks weigh pricing above $70-78 range
news.body: Demand strong on the first roadshow day, per reports. Up to $1.4tn fully diluted at the top. Prices Nov 18, trades Nov 19.

implications: One session moved the Fed debate from 0 vs 25bp to 25 vs 50bp. PPI on Nov 13 is the next input on size.
Equities are buying AI earnings into a tightening Fed. Cash bonds reopen Thursday and get their vote then.

watch.head: Cash Treasuries closed, stocks open
watch.body: Bond market shut for Veterans Day; NYSE trades. Futures carry the rate signal until Thursday.

watch.head: EIA crude inventories today
watch.body: Industry data showed a 9.8mb draw for the week to Nov 6. A matching official print backs the oil bounce.

watch.head: PPI Nov 13, 8:30
watch.body: PPI sharpens the read on the Fed's preferred gauge. A hot print keeps 50bp live for the FOMC on Dec 9.

watch.head: Lagarde speaks in Paris today
watch.body: ECB's Lane said Tuesday a December hike looks prudent on current data. Bund 10y 3.319% at Tuesday's close.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Core CPI 0.3% Tuesday vs 0.2% expected, third straight. December hike fully priced; 50bp odds 9-15% overnight.
10y auction tailed 1bp at 5.020%; dealers took 10%, most since May. The 2y move Tuesday was the largest since April 2025.
Brent $92.74, +1.3% (~4:45am ET), off an $89.16 overnight low. Fresh tanker attacks in Hormuz.
sections.positioning: No new COT extreme. Spec 2y longs 93rd %ile, 5y 94th, both 9+ weeks. Background: Tuesday's front-end selloff met long books.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Homebuilders led Tuesday's losses as the 10y briefly cleared 5%. Futures: S&P +0.6%, Nasdaq 100 +1.5%, Dow +0.2% (~3am ET).
Semis lead pre-market: memory and equipment names +5-7% (~4am ET).
Nikkei +1.3% at Wednesday's close. European stock futures +0.6% (~1am ET).
sections.positioning: Spec Russell 2000 longs 99th %ile, 6 weeks running. Background, not a trigger.

single_name.note: New to the screen Nov 9, score 3. Two insider rules fired; latest buy filed Nov 9. Above its 200-day line, 7.6 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Spread marks run to Monday's close. Tuesday's 10bp jump in the 10y is not in them yet.
Bank credit +6.3% y/y, week of Oct 28. That data predates Tuesday's repricing.
sections.positioning: No credit COT extreme this week. Listed BDCs at 0.89x NAV, as of Monday.
